Anthropic weighs project impact over time taken in engineer promotions

Anthropic's Katelyn Lesse says AI is changing how software engineers get promoted. Her team now weighs project impact over the time it takes to finish the work. The newly public company is also testing interviews that don't require candidates to write code by hand.

Reported by Business Insider.
